title: Report System By SigmaStudios
description: A professional player reporting system for Minecraft servers with Discord webhook integration.
body:
# Report System

A professional player reporting system for Minecraft servers with Discord integration.

## Features
- **In-game Reporting**: Players can easily report others with a simple command.
- **GUI Management**: Admins can view and manage all reports through a clean inventory interface.
- **Discord Webhooks**: Automatically send report notifications to your Discord server.
- **Chat Broadcasts**: Notify online staff members when a new report is filed.
- **Configurable**: Customize messages, prefixes, and webhook settings.

## Commands
- `/report <player> <reason>` - File a report against a player.
- `/reports` - Open the reports management GUI.
- `/reports reload` - Reload the plugin configuration.

## Permissions
- `reports.use` - Allows players to use the report command (default: true).
- `reports.check` - Allows staff to view and manage reports (default: op).
- `reports.reload` - Allows reloading the config (default: op).

## Requirements
- **Spigot/Paper** 1.13 or higher.
